entities.summary: Timur Gareev (b. 1988-03-03, Tashkent) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tashkent and Uzbekistan. Known in the fields of uzbekistan, journalists & chroniclers, asia.
